Yes! Our Plant Care Specialists are available by chat **9am–5pm Mon–Fri** (your local time). Since it's Saturday afternoon, they're not currently available, but you can reach them during weekday business hours.

In the meantime, you can also email **help@leafy.example** and a Plant Care Specialist will respond within 1 business day—or chat with our general support team now (we're open **8am–8pm Mon–Sat**) and they can offer some initial guidance. Calathea are generally hardy, so it's likely a watering or humidity issue; the care card that shipped with yours has tips to get started.
